correctness.rationale: Exact deterministic enumeration gives 2460 faces and an acyclic 1146-pair Morse matching verified by topological sort. The ordinary CW model has one critical vertex, 8 two-cells and 160 three-cells, no one-cells. All integer cancellation pivots are units. Its 8x160 attaching matrix has a 7-minor -1, 8-minor absolute 3, and rank7 mod3, implying Smith diagonal seven ones and a three. The simply connected 2-skeleton promotes this to a Moore space plus 152 three-spheres. Signed Lefschetz traces over all 120 S5 automorphisms and Murnaghan-Nakayama character inner products establish the full rational character. Embedded verifier reconstructs all inputs.

value.rationale: The complement of the Petersen graph is a canonical ten-vertex strongly regular graph with full S5 symmetry. Its matching complex has nontrivial integral three-torsion and a Moore summand, a genuine homotopy-level obstruction to sphere-wedge behavior invisible to rational homology and Euler characteristic. Its 152-dimensional rational S5 character resolves all isotypic components and identifies rational acyclicity of the full quotient. This natural invariant is useful for contrasting matching complexes of the Petersen graph and its complement; the result is not a parameter tweak of either prior theorem.
